title: calculate_import_taxes
description: Calculates Cambodia customs taxes for supported import cases and configured export cases. For documentation and rules, see DOCUMENTATION section below.

documentation.purpose: Input schema for customs duty, tax, and configured export tax calculations
documentation.applies_to: Goods imported into Cambodia, plus configured export cases such as rubber

critical_rules.action: Look up hs_code in hs_code_lookup.json using exact 8-digit code
critical_rules.error_handling: If 4-6 digits provided, return list of candidate 8-digit codes with descriptions

logic.else: Look up hs_code in duty_rates.csv for duty rate, special tax rate, and vat rate

critical_rules.note: FTA preferential rates not yet implemented - provide manual_rates if special agreement applies

critical_rules.description: Convert CIF to KHR if needed
critical_rules.action: If currency is not KHR, use exchange_rates.json with effective_date rate
All intermediate amounts rounded UP to 100 per rounding_rules.json

cif_value.description: CIF (Cost, Insurance, Freight) value - the customs valuation basis

declared_value.description: Optional DV (Deduction Value) override. DV is the fair amount of price used to keep the market in the middle, not too high or too low.

constraints.default_behavior: When omitted, calculator derives DV from customs value

declared_value_basis.description: How declared_value should be interpreted. Use per_ton for petroleum/rubber formulas that calculate DV (Deduction Value) x Exchange Rate x Net Mass / 1000.

dq_factor.description: Optional user-provided DQ (Deduction Quantity) adjustment factor. No backend registry — user must supply the factor directly.

constraints.used_when: dq_applicable is true or dq_factor differs from 1

dq_applicable.description: Whether a user-provided DQ (Deduction Quantity) adjustment applies.

hs_code.description: HS (Harmonized System) code for goods classification

constraints.ambiguity_handling: 4-6 digit codes trigger candidate list instead of calculation

hs_code.fallback: If omitted or invalid, must provide description for semantic lookup or manual_rates

description.description: Natural language description of goods for semantic HS code lookup
description.lookup_process: If provided, use hs_code_lookup methodology: search duty_rates.csv for matching product descriptions, return top candidates with HS codes and tax rates. See tools_contracts/json_schema/hs_code_lookup.schema.json for detailed lookup process.
description.use_when: HS code unknown, invalid, or ambiguous

origin_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'VN', 'CN', 'TH') - NOT YET USED

constraints.purpose: Reserved for future FTA preferential rates
constraints.current_status: Not implemented - provide manual_rates if needed

certificate_of_origin.description: Certificate of Origin document type - NOT YET IMPLEMENTED

constraints.purpose: Reserved for future FTA preferential rates
constraints.implementation_timeline: To be added when FTA rates needed

manual_rates.description: Override all lookup-based rates when user explicitly specifies rates

constraints.overrides: HS code lookup and FTA rules

special_tax.description: Special tax as percentage (for alcohol, tobacco, vehicles, luxury goods)

input_resolution_logic.when_hs_code_not_found_in_duty_rates: Return list of close matches or request manual_rates
input_resolution_logic.when_manual_rates_provided: Ignore lookup, use provided rates directly
input_resolution_logic.fta_rates_not_yet_supported: If user needs FTA rates, provide them via manual_rates
